{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–5 (Players Committee PDF slips). It is not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 5]] and not a GEMP environment.}}
'''Premiere - Original VS5''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] and [[Reflections III]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–5.<ref name="vs2002">[[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]</ref> [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time|Virtual Set 5]] (A Dark Time) was released about June 2003.<ref name="vs5">[[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]]</ref> The short name '''POVS5''' is used in GEMP importable deck file names.

Wiki decklists use this format when the newest original-era virtual card in the list comes from Virtual Set 5.
